title: Charge acquisition and later coherent use together
statement: Exact diagonal-adjoint law plus preserved pure reference force balanced-kernel access for the declared permutation/reset oracle family. A clean reversible lift/inverse would invert the underlying permutation,so total acquisition plus later use costs Omega(sqrt(d)) forward queries. The extension allows constant reference error while the diagonal law stays EXACT. It is not a distribution-free lower bound for approximate diagonal laws or all simulation outputs,and does not turn easy classical sampling into a claim of classical hardness.

requires: Permutation-plus-reset sources with forward XOR oracle access,exact diagonal-adjoint law and pure-reference preservation/declared constant reference error.
A clean reversible lift and inverse with the actual acquisition AND subsequent query costs included;no free permutation inversion.
